workItems.title: Build dependency-free polished browser Tetris app and logic checks
workItems.outcome: A locally runnable polished browser Tetris game with fair core mechanics, responsive visuals, keyboard/touch controls, persisted high score, docs, and automated logic sanity checks.
technicalRequirements: Implement all seven tetromino definitions with spawn, rotation, collision, locking, line clearing, scoring, levels, and game-over logic.
Use a seven-bag randomizer with visible next-piece queue and one-use-per-drop hold behavior.
Render main board, ghost piece, active piece, hold, next queue, score, lines, level, high score, pause, restart, and game-over states with polished responsive visuals.
Support keyboard controls for move, clockwise/counter-clockwise rotate, soft drop, hard drop, hold, pause/resume, and restart.
Support touch/on-screen controls on phone-sized screens and prevent page scrolling during gameplay.
Persist local high score through localStorage while keeping the app runnable without paid services or external APIs.
Add run instructions and a scripted Node sanity check for core game logic.

acceptanceCriteria.text: All seven tetrominoes spawn, rotate, collide, lock, and clear lines correctly.
Seven-bag randomizer, visible next queue, and hold support are implemented.
Keyboard controls cover move, both rotations, soft drop, hard drop, hold, pause, and restart.
Touch/on-screen controls work on phone-sized screens without page scrolling issues.
Scoring, level progression, high score, pause, restart, and game-over states are visible and correct.
Ghost piece, board state, animations, and visual feedback are polished for screenshot review.
Run instructions and at least one automated/scripted logic sanity check are included.

workItems.workerProfile: single frontend/gameplay implementer with vanilla JavaScript, CSS, and Node test coverage

checkResults.summary: Node sanity checks passed for seven-bag fairness, spawn/rotation/collision, line clear scoring, hold rules, and level progression.
Package dry-run passed with files list limited to README, app shell, server, source, and tests.
Local server smoke served the app shell and game module over http://localhost:4173 using curl.

acceptanceEvidenceItems.summary: GameCore exports all seven tetrominoes with four rotation states, collision checks, locking, line clears, and tests covering spawn, rotate, collide, lock, and clear behavior.
RandomBag implements shuffled seven-bag generation; UI renders five-piece next queue and hold canvas; GameCore enforces one hold per active piece and tests verify fairness and hold lock rules.
Keyboard handlers map move, clockwise/counter-clockwise rotation, soft drop, hard drop, hold, pause/resume, and restart, with README control instructions.
Pointer-driven on-screen controls include move, drops, both rotations, hold, pause, and restart; CSS and touchmove prevention disable page scrolling on phone-sized screens.
Score, level, lines, high score, playing/paused/game-over state, restart, and localStorage high-score persistence are implemented and displayed.
Canvas rendering includes polished gradients, board grid, ghost outline, active/locked block highlights, line-clear flash, hard-drop thump, responsive panels, hold, and next previews.
README documents local run/controls/checks and npm test provides the scripted game-logic sanity check.

implementationAssessment.maintainability: Core game rules are isolated in exported vanilla JavaScript classes/functions with a small UI wrapper, making logic testable without a browser.
implementationAssessment.simplicity: No runtime dependencies or paid services are used; a minimal Node static server and browser canvas keep setup straightforward.
implementationAssessment.projectStyle: Files follow the fresh benchmark project's module style and keep CodeWiki artifacts intact.
implementationAssessment.errorHandling: Collision, game-over, pause, hold-lock, localStorage parsing, server 404/405, and path traversal cases are handled conservatively.
implementationAssessment.uncertaintyResolution: All benchmark requirements were mapped to implementation evidence and checks; no unresolved implementation uncertainty remains.
implementationAssessment.rationale: The app is locally runnable, responsive, feature-complete for the requested Tetris benchmark, and backed by scripted logic checks.

sensitiveSurfaceAssessment.security: No authentication, network API, secrets, or remote code paths are introduced; the static server rejects path traversal and unsupported methods.
sensitiveSurfaceAssessment.privacy: Only a numeric high score is stored in localStorage under a game-specific key; no telemetry or external services are used.
sensitiveSurfaceAssessment.accessibility: Controls are real buttons with labels, keyboard shortcuts are documented and handled, status uses visible text/ARIA live toast, and contrast-focused styling is used; this is not a full WCAG audit.
sensitiveSurfaceAssessment.dependencyRisk: No third-party runtime dependencies were added; package.json only defines scripts and package files, and npm pack --dry-run passed.
sensitiveSurfaceAssessment.rationale: The changed UI, package, and local server surfaces were reviewed against the benchmark's local-only constraints.
